comment: Baselines recorded by the CI bench job (ubuntu-latest, JDK 25) on 2026-10-21. Allocation is bytes per operation, including the in-process broker; score is ops/s, or the p99 in microseconds for a sampled benchmark. The Kafka entries come from the CI recording of 2026-10-27 (run 40476505937), rounded, and with the throughput of the pipelined cases at 60% of it because one sample of a shared runner swung against local runs by a factor of two to four. The process case's allocation is background work of the Kafka client (its poll loop, network threads and heartbeats) divided by a rate set by the containerised broker, so it measured 42 kB to 138 kB per operation on different machines; its baseline is the CI figure and the gate protects against growth in the work per message, not that spread. Gates: allocation baseline + max(10%, 64 B), throughput floor 50% of baseline, p99 ceiling 2x baseline. Raising a budget needs a commit that says why; record a new file with -Dbudgets.record.
